note: The coverage floor: the least line coverage (percent) of the unit tests for these modules and files. 'run.sh coverage BASE' fails below it, reading this file from the base commit, so a change can't lower it for itself. Set a little under what was measured, so that only a real drop fails; raise it when coverage rises (README.md). Measured on 2026-10-19 (CI, llvm-cov 18): see the pull request that set each number.
